sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Fuinjutsu, Yin Release

system.description:
You activate a Yin seal currently on a creature with a truly terrifying jutsu, one that suppresses the ability think clearly. Select one creature you can see with a Yin Seal, as you force them to make a Charisma saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creatures is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is Confused.

Failure: Affected creature loses one of the following Proficiencies for the duration: One Weapon, One Saving throw (excluding Charisma), or One Skill. The affected creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they instead lose two proficiencies of your choice, of a different type than the original choice for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can increase the number of creatures you target by +1.
